response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship, mentoring, and open-source leadership credentials, but his career has centered on web/TypeScript/Node.js/DLang development rather than C++ or large-scale cloud compute platform work. The role explicitly requires 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years building large-scale infrastructure/distributed systems/compute platforms, which his resume does not demonstrate — his only C++ work was briefly at National Instruments (2014-2015) and a bachelor thesis project.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems)
Strong mentoring, teaching, and community-building track record (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
Experience with distributed/microservices infrastructure handling high-throughput real-time systems at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
concerns: Lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience — only minimal, non-recent C++ exposure
No demonstrated experience with cloud compute platforms, hardware architecture, or storage systems at the scale required
No explicit technical leadership title or scope managing cross-team priorities/timelines at the level this role demands

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud/compute infrastructure platform experience
Strong mentoring and technical leadership soft skills
